promoted_rules: EXTERNAL_REVIEW_MICROPACKETS: ask specialists only questions that unlock a gate; do not request broad rewrite.
REVIEW_TO_LOCK_FIREWALL: native/pro reviewer output never edits authority directly; it enters decision ledger then lock compiler.
BASELINE_BEFORE_CHALLENGER: create one strongest lead preview per role before challenger variants.
CREDENTIAL_SAFE_PREFLIGHT: authenticated capabilities may be persisted; secrets may not.
EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_REQUIRED: every PASS/HOLD/FAIL that can change production state needs provenance.
EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN_ROUTING: among eligible tasks, prefer uncertainty reduction and downstream unlock per unit cost.
SELF_IMPROVEMENT_PROMOTION_GATE: no universal runtime rule from model agreement alone.
BOUNDED_SLICE_BEFORE_FULL_RENDER: test 3–4 minutes before full episode when voice/render architecture is newly locked.
not_promoted: Any specific Russian terminology as human-native final truth
